test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an example of “agro based industries"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron and steel industry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iron and steel industry,** is NOT an example of "agro-based industries" because it does not involve the processing or manufacturing of agricultural products.
 
• Industries that rely on agricultural products derived from plants and animals are known as agro-based industries.
 
• Additionally, by processing and creating useful and marketable products, they increase the value of agricultural output.
 
• The textile, sugar, vegetable oil, tea, coffee, and leather goods sectors are a few instances of agro-based industries in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vegetable oil industry: This industry involves the processing of various oilseeds such as soybean, sunflower, palm, and canola into edible oils for cooking and other uses.
 
• Cotton textile industry: This industry involves the processing of cotton fibers into various textiles and fabrics for clothing, home furnishings, and other uses.
 
• Leather industry: This industry involves the processing of animal hides and skins into leather for various products such as shoes, bags, and furniture.
